AT0038.title: Account Rental Platforms
AT0038.description: Account rental platforms are online trading platforms that provide account rental services. Users can select rental accounts for desired games and server regions, make secure payments, and then experience the game. Account rental platforms allow players to enjoy better gaming experiences at minimal cost.

references.title: iQIYI, Youku and Tencent Video "Siege" Users with Rising Membership Fees, While Youku Limits Login to One Phone
